name: membrane associated guanylate kinase, WW and PDZ domain containing 2

function.text: MAGI2 encodes membrane-associated guanylate kinase, WW and PDZ domain-containing protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include signaling receptor complex adaptor activity and SMAD binding. It participates in signal transduction and SMAD protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include nephrotic syndrome 15 (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
